title: Red Hat Security Advisory: fence-agents security update
description: Multiple critical authentication bypass vulnerabilities have been identified in the pyjwt library used by the fence-agents packages in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.0 Extended Update Support. These vulnerabilities include acceptance of empty HMAC keys, improper public key validation, acceptance of DER public keys as HMAC secrets, unvalidated JWKS redirects, and token forgery via improper Unicode byte-order mark handling. The fence-agents packages are used for remote power management in cluster environments, allowing forced restart and removal of failed or unreachable nodes.
